title: Winged Cauldron
description: The official modpack of the Winged Cauldron server. Designed to be exploration and multiplayer focused.
body:
The official modpack of the Winged Cauldron server. Designed to be exploration and multiplayer focused. 

Main content mods (each with multiple addons and compat):
- Origins
- Create
- Quark
- Farmers Delight

Also mods for:
- World Generation
- Exploration and Strucutres
- Performance and Utility
